title: invoicing
text: Invoices go out on the first working day of the month. Hours come from the Toggl Track CSV export; one line per client project; day rate 850 EUR; Lexoffice for the invoice itself; reminders after 14 days. Contact for questions: [email]

title: launch-checklist
text: Every site launch: lighthouse > 90, alt texts German, 404 page, favicon, meta titles, cookie banner, redirects from old URLs, Search Console.
